name: Scroll Carousel 3D
description: Full-page scroll showcase where each scene is a 3D ring of image cards that spins as you scroll. Clicking a scene title flips into a staggered 3D preview grid with a close button.
contents: Scenes list, each with a title and a ring of images
Full-screen preview grid per scene with image captions and a close button
behavior: ScrollSmoother takes over page scrolling and scrubs each ring's rotation and card brightness with scroll
Scene titles reveal character by character when entering view
Clicking a title scrolls the scene to center, spins the ring away and fans in a 3D preview grid
Close returns to the carousel with a reverse animation; user scroll is locked during transitions
editableByProps: Scene titles, images, ring radius and number of scenes
Preview captions, close label, colors, card shape and grid columns

needsCodeEdit.change: Change the scroll rotation amount of the rings
Change preview images independent of scene images
needsCodeEdit.where: previewImages constant in the preview map

fixed: Takes over page scrolling with ScrollSmoother and normalizeScroll, so it should be the only smooth scroll on the page
Temporarily blocks wheel, touch and key scrolling during open transitions and removes the blocks afterward
Scroll wrapper is fixed to the viewport and fills the screen
Each scene is one viewport tall, which provides the scroll range for the effect
Preview images are cycled from the built-in image list
